brief.text: Elon Musk said Ukraine's military violated Starlink terms of service by using the service for offensive drone strikes.
Ukraine disputed the claim, saying commercial Starlink limits prevented medium- and long-range strike use.
Ukraine's access to Starlink and Starshield has been restored to previous speeds, according to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

headline.text: Musk says Ukraine violated Starlink terms; Ukraine disputes the claim

timeline.event: Starlink service in Ukraine restored to previous speeds after Musk-linked speed restriction.
Musk posted that using Starlink for offensive drone strikes has never been allowed.

key_facts.text: Musk said Starlink is critical to Ukraine's defense and the front line would collapse immediately if it were turned off.
Musk said the loophole that allowed the strikes was closed last week.
Ukraine's access to Starlink and Starshield has been restored to previous speeds.

background.text: Musk said Starlink restrictions were the reason for the speed limits on Ukraine's service.
A Wall Street Journal report said Trump reached out directly to Musk and demanded he undo the slowdown on Starshield.

whats_next.text: Sen. Adam Schiff demanded that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth testify on Capitol Hill about the removal of speed restrictions.

why_it_matters.text: Ukrainian officials said the speed restrictions significantly impaired their drone operations.
Rep. Jason Crow said Musk having the ability to cut off Starlink access to Ukraine is beyond disturbing to him.
